canonical_name: Connectedness of the Mandelbrot set (source theorem family)
statement_blocker: The catalog identifies Mandelbrot-set connectedness but supplies no source edition, definition, binders, or proof boundary. The 1982 note and Orsay Corollary 8.3 are strong primary candidates, but their exact edition relationship, incorporated definitions, critical-orbit and filled-Julia transports, connectedness convention, translation, corrections, errata, and independent review are not accepted. Freezing an exact Lean proposition now would silently choose among proposition-changing encodings and could mishandle the duplicate THM-M-0261 record.
domain_and_universes: Prospective domain: c and z in mathlib Complex, natural-number iteration of the normalized quadratic family, a parameter subset of Complex with the inherited Euclidean topology, and Prop in universe 0. Exact source definitions and the ambient-plane versus Riemann-sphere boundary remain open.
conclusion: Prospective conclusion: ordinary topological connectedness of the source-defined Mandelbrot parameter locus. The exact set definition, nonemptiness component, and connected versus preconnected encoding remain open until source and statement review.

alternate_encodings.target: The parameters c for which the filled Julia set of z |-> z^2 + c is connected form a connected subset of Complex.
